## field: user
<context>
- 30 students, mixed reading levels, 4 English learners
- We have spinach leaves, baking soda, syringes and cups, but no microscopes
</context>

<task>
Plan a 45-minute lesson that helps my 7th graders understand photosynthesis well enough to explain it to a friend.
Deliverable: a 45-minute lesson plan with a hands-on activity
</task>

<outline>
1. Hook: a question students can argue about
2. Mini-lesson: inputs and outputs, with a diagram
3. Activity: floating leaf-disk experiment in groups
4. Exit ticket: explain it to a friend in 3 sentences
</outline>

<constraints>
- Timings must add up to 45 minutes
- Include one support for English learners
</constraints>

<output_format>
Format: markdown
Sections, in order: Objectives; Materials; Timeline; Differentiation; Assessment
</output_format>

<success_criteria>

- Every timeline step has minutes
- Uses only the listed materials
</success_criteria>
